api_changes.detail: The quickstart shows an OpenAI client with base_url https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1 and POST https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions. This sample only changes the model field.

code_change.before:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-20b",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
code_change.after:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="accounts/fireworks/models/qwen3-8b",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
